purpose: Exercise circular JavaScript values without importing candidate code into the trusted node:test process.

operations.inspect: Read bounded installed-package metadata and verify callable root exports.
operations.stringify: Construct one allowlisted graph fixture in the child and call stringify with an allowlisted replacer and space option.
operations.parse: Call parse with an allowlisted reviver and return a bounded canonical graph observation.
operations.roundtrip: Stringify and parse one allowlisted fixture and report identity and graph observations.
operations.toJSON: Call toJSON for one allowlisted fixture and return its acyclic JSON table.
operations.fromJSON: Call fromJSON for a bounded JSON table and return graph observations.
operations.helpersRoundtrip: Apply fromJSON(toJSON(fixture)) and return graph observations.
